shortDescription: This module manages the change volume for a given volume on IBM Spectrum Virtualize family storage systems

options.name: basevolume
options.description: Specifies the base volume name (master or auxiliary). Required when I(state=present), to create the change volume.

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: cvname
options.description: Specifies the name to assign to the master or auxiliary change volume.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: ismaster
options.description: Specifies whether the change volume is being (dis)associated with master cluster. Required when the change volume is being associated or disassociated from the master cluster.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: rname
options.description: Specifies the name of the remote copy relationship.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates or updates (C(present)) or removes (C(absent)), a change volume.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the ibm_svc_auth module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.
